title: Launch Tempo Harmonizer and Cross-Service Drift Mitigator
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: As runtime/console/api teams scale release cadence, we observe drift in planned launch windows: deferred cutovers, uncoordinated canaries across surfaces, and capacity contention at the regional level. Current artifacts (calendar spreadsheets + ad-hoc Slack threads) are insufficient to keep multi-surface launch trains aligned or to prevent last-minute rollbacks.

This ticket builds the product-managed 'Tempo Harmonizer' for the quarterly launch calendar plus a 'Drift Mitigator' process and lightweight tooling to detect and correct schedule drift across runtime, console, and API release trains. The outcome is a predictable launch cadence with explicit corrective actions, better capacity hedging, and reduced emergency rollbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Centralized launch timetable view in the Console that shows per-train milestones (staging cutover, canary windows, regional blackouts) for runtime/console/api
Automated drift detection that flags a launch when a milestone slips >48 hours and surfaces recommended mitigations
A documented cutover escalation flow and playbook linked from each launch entry
2-week pilot run with three internal product teams where drift alerts were generated and used to re-schedule or execute hedges
Post-pilot metric: reduce last-minute (>72h) cutover deferrals by 40% for participating trains
milestones: 2026-03-17 - Stakeholder alignment and success criteria sign-off
2026-03-24 - Minimal Console mockup and data contract (calendar + milestone schema)
2026-04-07 - Backend signal pipeline for milestone state + drift rules (alpha)
2026-04-21 - Pilot integration with two runtime release lanes and console UI
2026-05-01 - Pilot review, iterate, and ship playbook + runbook updates
stakeholders: Ops Oncall Rotation - launch escalation recipients
Customer Success - communications for impacted customers
risks: Data freshness: milestone state depends on multiple teams publishing status—latency can cause false positives
Organizational adoption: teams may ignore drift alerts without clear incentives or SLA consequences
Capacity hedging accuracy: incorrect hedges may increase costs if over-provisioned
Edge cases for rapid hotfixes that legitimately shift windows—must avoid noisy alerts
communication_plan: Weekly triage with runtime/console/api leads during pilot. Drift alerts post to #launch-tempo in Slack with structured payload (train, milestone, delta, recommended action). Bi-weekly pilot demo to GTM and SRE. Customer-facing communications templated in Drive and routed through Customer Success for any visible customer impact.
